scene yukikaorishere1
: The words that fell from your mouth just now...how much truth do they possess?
: You are...dying?
: You...weren’t supposed to hear any of that, Kaori.
: But...I did hear it. And your appearance is not that of one who dies even if your color is less colorful now than it has been in the past.
: Yeah, well...life fucking sucks. What do you want from me?
: Honesty...
: If there is fear in your heart, it helps to have someone who will listen to its beating. Someone to strike fear into the heart of fear itself so the fear’s heart becomes fearful itself.
: But I fear that you won’t do that. Which makes me fearful.
: Will I lose you too now?
: You...shouldn’t be here, Kaori...
: Why...are you here anyway? I haven’t seen you in months.
scene yukikaorishere2
: My reasons lack importance now! What matters is that I am here! Even if I am not the one you want, I am the one you have! So have me! Speak the words that deserve speaking!
scene yukikaorishere3
: But everything...becomes more real when I start to talk about it...and I...it’s just...
: Things have already become real now that there are tears where there haven’t been before.
: The Yukiburger I know is strong...And violent, but not necessarily in a negative way. She would not stand here in the dark with a wet face and an armful of secrets!
scene yukikaorishere4
: That Yuki’s already gone, Kaori...You get the old me now. The one who’d trade anything and everything for one more night of feeling alive.
: And yeah...I’m probably dying. If you want the truth...I’m probably dying. Which means I might not have many nights left at all. So do yourself a favor and just...
: Just bail out while you can, okay? Every second you stay here adds another day you’ll have to mourn me.
scene yukikaorishere5
: And every second I am not here adds another where you will be afraid.
: I will mourn for however long you think it takes to prevent that for you. That is what it means to be family. I think.
: Haven’t you mourned enough already?...
: If I have, I can’t remember it. So it’s like I’ve never mourned at all. Maybe I will enjoy it? And spending each day remembering you will not be as sad as you expect.
: Now explain to me — why are you leaving this place?
: Please let me listen to your heart.
scene yukikaorishere6
: What’s even the point?
: It’s not like you’d hear anything if I did.
scene yukikaorishere7
: In fact, I don’t think it’s beaten a single fucking time since I was a teenager.
: So...heh...maybe I’m overreacting?...
: Maybe I’ve been dead this whole time and you’ve been cozying up to a fucking zombie pretending to still have some reason to be here.
: What’s that say about you, huh? That you’d waste so much time and effort on something already beyond saving? Don’t you have better shit to do, Kaori?
: Just get the fuck out of here, okay? You never should have come in the first place.
scene yukikaorishere8
: You opened the door.
: You would not have opened the door if you did not want to be saved. So there is something inside of you that is begging for help.
: Would you like me to keep you alive, Aunt Yuki?
: And how would you do that, Kaori?...Not everyone can be fucking...Frankensteined back to life like you were. And not all of us deserve it either.
: It is not up to you to decide who is and is not worthy of life. The gods don’t like it when you pretend to be them, Aunt Yuki.
scene yukikaorishere9
: What- you religious now? Is that what you meant by “keeping me alive?” Think a prayer circle’s gonna fix my lungs?
: Not at all.
: In fact, I think breathing as a whole isn’t all it’s cracked up to be.
scene yukikaorishere10
scene yukikaorishere11
: Look at you — flailing around like a fish washed ashore, waiting for your bones to be picked clean by some sort of carnivorous bird.
: What would you say to those who died fighting? Who actually tried? That they were foolish for wanting to stay here — in a place that has so regularly fucked you, Aunt Yuki?
: Should I have died too? For I had done nothing to deserve life besides want it.
: Or perhaps I’ve become a zombie as well? Perhaps I did die. And everything I do now is pointless and dull and just delaying an inevitable second death.
: Jesus...between Yumi talkin’ to herself and your eyes fuckin’ changing colors, I’ve gotta be way higher than I thought I was.
: Your time will most assuredly come — but only if the clock keeps ticking.
: Which means that all you need to do is stop it. And that’s much easier than it sounds, I think.
scene happy9
scene happy8
scene yukikaorishere12
: Ah.
: Yeah...you think a lot of shit, Kaori. And with all due respect, basically all of it is bullshit.
scene yukikaorishere13
: But I’ve gotta applaud your...positivity at least. You and Rika do a damn good job of making me slightly more optimistic about decomposing in the near future.
: J...Just tell me what I can do to help you! Anything!
: You got any money?...
: Money?
: Yeah...need it for laundry and shit like that.
: How many moneys do you require? My portable rectangle holder is inside of my housebox right now, so all I have are circles. Would you like the big circle? The medium circle? The small-
: I...uhh...I can wait until you have your...rectangle holder again. Got...lots of clothes to wash...
: I know this is true because you are currently naked. I thank you for no longer lying to me.
: But what about fixing your body? How many moneys-
: Nothing’s fixing me, Kaori. It ain’t happenin’.
: But there’s shit that can make what’s left of my time here more bearable...and it just...
: I feel more comfortable focusin’ on that instead of what comes after...
scene black
scene yukikaorishere14
Despite the incessant pleas for her departure, Kaori Kadowaki refused to leave her aunt’s side — offering up her lap as a pillow in the dying woman’s time of need.
But was she really dying at all? Because dying implies that a result will be reached. And based on what the girl inside of the girl said, that would require some help from time itself.
If that final day could never be reached, would it really still be dying? Or would she simply just be sick?
These are the questions I must ask myself as an observer deprived of the facts that would necessitate the completion of an unending thought.
And this thought is just one that serves as the foundation for this place as a whole.
What if the ones we loved could never leave?
What if everyone loved us in general?
How would that world look? And if you were to somehow, by unconventional means, find out how to venture outside of it — how would things look there?
Maybe you’d be an unwelcome visitor in someone else’s paradise?
Maybe you already are?
In any case — squatters have rights too. And Yuki Yamaguchi was all too familiar with this as she’d spent the vast majority of her life sleeping anywhere she could find.
That said, if she were to die in this room, that alone could be called a victory — albeit one much too small for how hard she’d fought to get here.
Unfortunately, with no source of income, this could be gone at any moment. And the chances of her continuing her fight dwindled by the minute as her opponent was a dragon this time.
And despite Yuki having been a bit of a dragon herself in her younger years, those days were long gone. She healed slower. Got tired quicker. Lacked any sort of substantial motivation.
But the thing that pushed her closer to retirement wasn’t any of that. In fact, it was something much simpler.
She just didn’t know what she was even trying to “win” anymore.
What was the prize? Just more of this?
More pain?
More knowing that something terrible could happen at any moment and take everything away?
She was right to be scared.
And everyone who isn’t is wrong.
But does that mean one should just give up?
This is one more question I must ask myself as an observer deprived of the facts that would necessitate the completion of an unending thought.
Just there is no thought more unending than the one currently swimming through the drug-addled mind of a thankless burnout.
: I’m scared, Kaori...
: I know, Aunt Yuki...
: I don’t want to die...
: You won’t...
: You will stay here...and we will go somewhere nice with Nao-chan. Somewhere with all the dizzy drinks and smoke-tubes your heart could ever desire.
: Don’t give me hope...it’s the last thing I need.
: But it could be the first.
: What if hope is all you need? And everything else comes after?
: That sort of thing doesn’t save people. Just makes them angrier when it don’t work out the way they want.
: Knew this girl once...young. Got attacked one night. Found her beaten so bad she couldn’t move.
: We rushed her to the hospital. Stayed there for a week, livin’ off of free coffee and food we’d snatch off carts left out in the halls.
: Did you not drink the juice? I drank many juices when I was in the hospital. So many that I became juice myself.
: Sometimes, maybe? But anyway, five days in, girl regained some feeling in her legs. Doctors said it was a good sign. That she might be able to walk again if things kept improving.
: And...did they?...
: What do you think?...Wouldn’t be tellin’ this story if it had a happy ending.
: We all got in on it. Started hyping her up. Tellin’ her she’d be fine in no time at all.
: Day seven, the feeling was gone again. Just...went away.
: And never came back.
: Still remember the look on her face. The...realization. Panic. The tone of the doc’s voice from the hallway when we heard him ordering more tests.
: She was a little fireball, that girl. Started throwin’ shit around and screaming at the nurses about how fucked up it was to make her think she had a shot at bein’ normal again.
: That’s when they made us leave. Surprised they let us stay as long as they did, to be honest.
: But ever since then, I’ve had a hard time tryin’ to look on the bright side when it comes to shit like this. Think that expectin’ the best just makes anythin’ else feel like the worst.
: I don’t want my last thoughts on this planet to be cursin’ out whoever it is that made me think I had a shot.
: I’m sorry, Aunt Yuki...
: I don’t know what other words would help right now...
scene yukikaorishere15
: I already told you...there ain’t nothin’ that can help, Kaori.
: But...thank you for being here...
: It’s nice...this warmth...
: If only you did not have so much laundry to feed to the clean-machine. Then you could put on a thick jacket-coat and become even less cold.
: Do not worry, Yukiburger. Soon, I will provide you with all of the paper rectangles in my-
: Just keep the money, Kaori. I changed my mind.
: What? But how will you-
: I got one lifeline, still. Don’t worry.
: You mind doin’ somethin’ else for me, though? Doesn’t have to be now, just...whenever I’m gone.
scene yukikaorishere16
: I do not like the idea of making a promise that will only matter after you have left me behind.
: It’s because I’m leavin’ you behind that I’m askin’ at all.
: Then...what would you like from me?
: Kaori, I...know you don’t remember her...and I know she’ll probably make it difficult for you, but...
: If you could look after Yumi when I’m gone...I’d really appreciate that...
: The Yumi is your daughterburger, yes?
: That’s right...and your cousin...
: You two would play together when you were little...you were kind of like a role model to her...being older and...shit like that...
: Can you tell me what sorts of roles I modeled so I may better replicate our prior connection when you have departed?
: I ain’t askin’ you to be your old self and take her under your wing or anything like that, just...
: She could use some friends...and I know you like makin’ em...
: But what if she doesn’t like me? There are many people who seem to misunderstand the person I am.
: Honestly, she probably won’t like you. It won’t be personal, though. She doesn’t like anybody.
: Then why do you want me to-
: Because you’re all she’ll have.
: You and that fuckin’ blonde girl who nearly killed Gary at least...but she doesn’t like me much and I can’t imagine she’d feel any better about me now.
: Does the Yumi know that you think you are dying as well?
scene yukikaorishere17
: I don’t just think it...I know it. It’s real, Kaori. And yeah...Yumi knows. She found out by bein’ a fuckin’ nosy bitch. Same as you.
: Guess it runs in the family.
: I am sorry that I overheard your secret...but I am also glad because it brought us together.
: Mhm...sure...
: Now, you gonna tell me why you came over here in the first place? Or do you want me to go fuck myself one last time before I can’t anymore?
: I can give you privacy if that is something you would like to do. I do not believe I am supposed to watch other people’s private time.
: Not like that, you fucking idiot.
: I am sorry, Aunt Yukiburger. I am still only a fucking novice.
: Whatever you are, promise me you’ll look after Yumi...okay?
: I’m trusting you to do what I couldn’t.
: Please...it’d...
scene yukikaorishere18
: Make me...
scene yukikaorishere19
: Mn...hngh!
: Aunt Yukiburger?! Is it happening?! Should I dial the numbers?!
: Just a...sudden headache! Don’t...worry about it!
scene black
: I will obtain the blood of the ocean for you to consume! Stay right there!
: There’s...a can of beer I haven’t finished near the-
: Refused! The ocean blood will fix your head. You have not done enough of the hydrating.
: Mn...aah...f...fine! Just fucking...ngh!
scene bedroom_night
I hope that Yuki was able to tell Yumi everything tonight.
But more than that, I hope that Yumi was able to understand it.
And I hope that soon enough, I’ll be able to as well.
scene black
I crawl into bed beside someone who’s already asleep and silently whisper “goodnight” to her.
And while I half-expect to hear someone uninvited whisper it back from the corner of the room, there is nothing but silence.
There is nothing but silence.
There is nothing.
